about: discord: keys Hermes reads that the dashboard export of an empty profile does not list. tools/hermes_source_keys.py finds the keys in the Hermes source; this file gives each one its type, closed value set, default and description (checked against the Hermes source; the docs lag behind it). row: the code proves the Discord adapter reads it, so the app shows it as a row under Discord (false: only described when a config has it). Keys the export already lists are taken from the export and need no entry here.

allow_bots.description: Messages from other Discord bots: none ignores them, mentions accepts only bot messages that @mention this bot, all accepts every bot message. Either enabled mode still needs a typed inline mention unless bots_require_inline_mention is false. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_BOTS wins.

allow_from.description: Discord user IDs or usernames allowed to use the bot (comma-separated or a YAML list; * allows everyone). Without this or allowed_roles, everyone is denied unless allow_all_users is true or allowed_channels scopes server access. Usernames turn on the Server Members intent. Env DISCORD_ALLOWED_USERS wins.

allowed_users.description: Older name of allow_from; Hermes still reads it when allow_from is not set.

allowed_roles.description: Discord role IDs (comma-separated or a YAML list); any member with one of these roles is allowed, in addition to allow_from. Turns on the Server Members intent. Env DISCORD_ALLOWED_ROLES wins.

allow_all_users.description: Allow every Discord user who can reach the bot. Only for trusted or private servers. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_ALL_USERS wins.

allow_admin_from.description: User IDs that may run every slash command in DMs. Users not listed may only run user_allowed_commands (plus /help and /whoami). Unset: no slash command gating.

user_allowed_commands.description: Slash commands that allowed users who are not in allow_admin_from may run in DMs (/help and /whoami are always allowed).

require_admin_for_exec_approval.description: Only users in allow_admin_from may click command-approval buttons. With nobody in allow_admin_from the buttons work for no one.

allow_mentions.description: What the bot may ping. Safe defaults: no @everyone/@here, no @role.

allow_mentions.everyone.description: Let the bot ping @everyone and @here. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_MENTION_EVERYONE wins.

allow_mentions.roles.description: Let the bot ping @role mentions. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_MENTION_ROLES wins.

allow_mentions.users.description: Let the bot ping individual users. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_MENTION_USERS wins.

allow_mentions.replied_user.description: A reply pings the author of the original message. Env DISCORD_ALLOW_MENTION_REPLIED_USER wins.

ignored_channels.description: Channel IDs where the bot never responds, even when mentioned (comma-separated or a YAML list; * ignores every server channel). Checked after allowed_channels, before mentions and free-response channels. Env DISCORD_IGNORED_CHANNELS wins.

no_thread_channels.description: Channel IDs where the bot answers in the channel instead of creating a thread (comma-separated or a YAML list). Only matters when auto_thread is true. Env DISCORD_NO_THREAD_CHANNELS wins.

reply_to_mode.description: Reply reference on the bot's messages: off never, first on the first chunk only, all on every chunk. Env DISCORD_REPLY_TO_MODE wins.

slash_commands.description: Register Hermes' slash commands (built-ins and installed skills) with Discord at startup. Turn off on every gateway but one when several share one Discord application.

group_sessions_per_user.description: In shared channels each user gets their own session. Read by the Discord adapter for its session keys (default true), separately from the top-level group_sessions_per_user that the gateway reads.

thread_sessions_per_user.description: In threads each user gets their own session (default: one session per thread). Read by the Discord adapter for its session keys, separately from the top-level setting.

channel_skill_bindings.description: Skills bound to specific channels (Discord and Slack).

liveness_interval_seconds.description: Older name of websocket_liveness_interval_seconds; still read.

liveness_failure_threshold.description: Older name of websocket_liveness_failure_threshold; still read.

unauthorized_dm_behavior.description: What happens when someone who is not allowed sends a DM: pair offers pairing, ignore stays silent, decline replies with a refusal. Overrides the top-level unauthorized_dm_behavior for Discord.

notice_delivery.description: Where Hermes posts its notices: public in the channel, private to the user.

gateway_restart_notification.description: Post a 'gateway online / restarted' message on this platform.

typing_status_text.description: Status text shown while the agent works. Used by Slack and Google Chat only; the Discord adapter does not read it.

reply_prefix.description: Shared chat-platform key: Hermes copies it from every platform block, but the Discord adapter is not known to use it (other platforms do).
